subject: general
question:
Identify from the given options the word which is similar in meaning to the following word.

Equivocal
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"equivocal"** means open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous. (संदिग्ध) • **Example: **His reply to my question was **equivocal,** leaving me unsure of what he actually meant. • **"Ambiguous"** refers to something that is unclear or can be understood in more than one way. (अस्पष्ट) • **Example: **The contract's language was **ambiguous**, causing confusion among the parties involved. • Hence, we can infer that the word **'equivocal'** is similar in meaning to **'ambiguous'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Ambiguous. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Clear** (स्पष्ट): Easily understood and without ambiguity. • **Example:** The instructions were clear, making the process simple to follow. • **Representative** (प्रतिनिधि): Serving as a typical example of something. • **Example:** The paintings are representative of the artist's early work. • **Balanced** (संतुलित): Keeping or showing a balance; even distribution. • **Example:** She has a balanced approach to work and personal life. 124:T6ea,
